metadata.question: Was the land surface temperature, captured with MODIS Terra, in New York higher on July 20-27, 2016 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?

data.raw_code: The question: "Was the land surface temperature, captured with MODIS Terra, in New York higher on July 20-27, 2016 than the 2001-2010 average for the same period?" Steps: 1. Data: MODIS Terra Land Surface Temperature (LST) product. The MODIS Terra product for LST is MOD11A2 (8-day composite) or MOD11A1 (daily). Since we are comparing a specific 8-day period (July 20-27) to the average of the same period over 2001-2010, we can use MOD11A2 (8-day composite) which is available from 2000 onward. The band for LST is 'LST_Day_1km' (in Kelvin, scale factor 0.02). We'll convert to Celsius. 2. Location: New York. We'll use a point for New York City (latitude: 40.7128, longitude: -74.0060) with a buffer of 10 km to get an average over the city. 3. Dates: - For 2016: July 20-27, 2016. We can get the MODIS Terra 8-day composite that starts on July 20, 2016. - For the 2001-2010 average: We need to get all MODIS Terra images for the same 8-day period (July 20-27) for each year from 2001 to 2010, then average them. 4. Cloud masking: Use the quality band 'QC_Day' to mask out poor quality pixels. According to the MOD11A2 user guide, the QC_Day band has bits 0-1 for LST quality (00=good, 01=average, 10=bad, 11=not set). We'll mask out if bits 0-1 are 10 or 11. 5. Processing: - For 2016: Get the image for July 20-27, 2016. Apply quality masking, then compute the mean LST over the region in Celsius. - For 2001-2010: For each year, get the image for the same 8-day period (July 20-27) and compute the mean. Then average these 10 values to get the 2001-2010 average for that period. 6. Check for data availability (C1 if no images) and valid pixels (C2 if after masking there are no pixels). 7. Compare: If 2016 mean LST > 2001-2010 average, then answer A (Yes), else B (No). Edge Cases: - If no image for 2016, then C1. - If the 2001-2010 collection for the period is empty for any year, then C1. - After masking, if no valid pixels in the region for either, then C2. We'll structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var geometry = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.0060, 40.7128]).buffer(10000); // 10 km buffer around NYC var start2016 = '2016-07-20'; var end2016 = '2016-07-27'; var years = ee.List.sequence(2001, 2010); // Function to mask LST image using QC band function maskLST(image) { var lst = image.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // Convert to Celsius var qc = image.select('QC_Day'); var qualityMask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2); // Keep bits 0-1 = 00 or 01 return lst.updateMask(qualityMask); } // 2. Data Acquisition for 2016 var col2016 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(start2016, end2016); var count2016 = col2016.size().getInfo(); if (count2016 === 0) { print("2016 Images: 0"); print("C1"); return; } var img2016 = maskLST(col2016.first()); // Check valid pixels for 2016 var stats2016 = img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var countValid2016 = stats2016.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); if (countValid2016 === 0) { print("2016 Valid Pixels: 0"); print("C2"); return; } var mean2016 = img2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); // 3. Data Acquisition for 2001-2010 var yearMeans = []; var hasMissing = false; var hasZeroPixels = false; for (var i = 2001; i <= 2010; i++) { var start = i + '-07-20'; var end = i + '-07-27'; var col = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A2') .filterBounds(geometry) .filterDate(start, end); var count = col.size().getInfo(); if (count === 0) { print(i + " Images: 0"); hasMissing = true; break; } var img = maskLST(col.first()); // Check valid pixels var stats = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var countValid = stats.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); if (countValid === 0) { print(i + " Valid Pixels: 0"); hasZeroPixels = true; break; } var mean = img.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: geometry, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); yearMeans.push(mean); print(i + " Mean: " + mean.toFixed(2) + " C, Pixels: " + countValid); } if (hasMissing) { print("C1"); return; } if (hasZeroPixels) { print("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate 2001-2010 average var sum = 0; for (var j = 0; j < yearMeans.length; j++) { sum += yearMeans[j]; } var avg2001_2010 = sum / yearMeans.length; // 5. Validation & Final Answer print("2016 Mean: " + mean2016.toFixed(2) + " C, Pixels: " + countValid2016); print("2001-2010 Avg: " + avg2001_2010.toFixed(2) + " C"); if (mean2016 === null || avg2001_2010 === null || isNaN(mean2016) || isNaN(avg2001_2010) || mean2016 > 100 || mean2016 < -100 || avg2001_2010 > 100 || avg2001_2010 < -100) { print("C3"); } else if (mean2016 > avg2001_2010) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
